summaryEvents.text: Calibration is complete. The connector sits lower in this grasp, so the agent adjusts its approach from the camera views.
The tip contacts the socket face. Small translations align it with the opening and inner guide while orientation stays fixed.
Both wrist views confirm entry and match the saved reference. The agent proceeds with insertion and checks progress after each push.
All three views match the saved seated state. The agent stops pushing and prepares to ease preload, release and withdraw.
